_comment: Manifest of the game-data sources the guide is built from. Read by check_sources.py. Holds NO local versions or pull dates: the script reads those live from the data files. Placeholders in pull steps: {version}, {zip}, {build}, {tables}.

sources.source: QuestieDB Forever, decoded to JSON by tooling/questiedb_baked.py from the official Questie release bundle

upstream.read: newest release tag starting "bundle/"; Forever DB version = the part after "+v" (bundle/v12.3.1+v1.0.9 -> 1.0.9)

pull: download {zip} from the GitHub release with tag bundle/..+v{version} (https://github.com/Questie/Questie/releases) and unzip it into a scratch folder
python tooling/questiedb_baked.py <unzipped>\QuestieDB\QuestieDB_Forever.toc tooling\qdb
python tooling/check_guide.py and python tooling/verify.py --all, then review the diff before committing
sources.notes: See tooling/README.txt, "17 Oct 2026 additions". Decoded rows have no XP field.

sources.source: Forever client DB2 tables as CSV from wago.tools, pinned per build

upstream.read: key "wowf": list of {version, created_at}; newest by created_at

pull: mkdir tooling/client/{build}
for each T in {tables}: curl -A "Mozilla/5.0" -o tooling/client/{build}/<T>.csv "https://wago.tools/db2/<T>/csv?build={build}"
update tooling/client/README.txt for the new build
sources.notes: Nothing reads these tables yet. wago.tools needs a browser-like User-Agent.

sources.source: Wowhead Forever quest XP per zone, pulled through a real browser
sources.local_read: each zone file key "_browser_refresh" (ISO date of its last browser pull; null or absent if never browser-pulled)

upstream.read: a zone is stale when the newest wowf build's created_at date (from the client source) is after its _browser_refresh date

pull: open https://www.wowhead.com/forever/zone=<id> in a real browser
run tooling/wh_zone_listview.js in the console to get a TSV block
python tooling/ingest_zone_tsv.py < block.tsv (raw copies land in data/browser/)
about 14 pages in a row trips a CloudFront 403; wait a few minutes
sources.notes: See tooling/README.txt, "17 Oct 2026 - quest XP via the browser". Staleness here is a proxy: a new client build does not always change quest XP. 4 Nov 2026: the zone files also carry quest money (field money; tooling/gold.py sums it per chapter), and the Wowhead Forever NPC pages carry trainer costs (teaches-ability listview, trainingcost) - browser only, about 25 fetches per burst; see docs/audit-2026-11-04.md.

sources.source: Forever item tooltips (stats, drop chance) from the nether Wowhead endpoint, cached as plain text by tooling/fetch_tooltips.py
sources.local_read: newest file's date in its name (weights/tooltips/YYYY-MM-DD.json); fallback weights/item_tooltips.json, the 24 Sep 2026 scrape, dated by "fallback_date"

upstream.read: stale when the newest wowf build's created_at date (from the client source) is after the local date

pull: python tooling/dungeon_loot.py lists the item ids that have no tooltip yet; save them to ids.txt
python tooling/fetch_tooltips.py --from-file ids.txt (one request per second; writes weights/tooltips/<today>.json, never weights/item_tooltips.json)
sources.notes: Staleness is a proxy, as for wowhead_xp. Forever item stats changed between 24 Sep and 29 Oct for most items spot-checked (e.g. 270256, 271096), so item_tooltips.json is unreliable for scoring. A partial cache (a few test items) still counts as fresh by date; check its item count.

sources.source: PandaQuest community addon, Database/Forever/Overrides/Wowhead.lua: Forever quest/NPC data generated from Wowhead (GPL-3, third-party, treat as untrusted)
sources.local_read: none, not used by any tool yet

upstream.read: INFO "empty" if its quests = {} table is empty; INFO "HAS DATA (N rewardXP entries)" if it holds rewardXP entries (comment lines ignored)

sources.notes: Informational only. Empty on 29 Oct 2026. If it fills after launch it is a possible scriptable source of Forever quest XP (rewardXP) and NPC data.

sources.source: salty-max/wow-data community SQLite of Forever data; third-party, treat as untrusted
sources.local_read: none, not used by any tool yet

sources.source: DoggsProbe in-game logs, converted by probe/probe2json.py
sources.notes: After launch (4 Nov): install DoggsProbe, /reload before quitting, convert SavedVariables with probe2json.py.

sources.source: Polestar Guides (fitzforge/polestar, GPL-3, third-party, treat as untrusted): the Alliance Skyborne Zephras Isle route, used only as an ORDER reference for the warrior guide's 00s/00t chapters, never as data

upstream.read: INFO "identical" if the raw file equals the local copy line for line, else INFO "upstream differs" with the line counts

pull: curl -A "Mozilla/5.0" -o compare/polestar-0.2.6/01-zephras-isle.guide <url>
update compare/polestar-0.2.6/README.txt with the new version and pull date, then diff the step order against guide/Guidelime_ForeverWarrior/00s_*.lua and 00t_*.lua
sources.notes: Informational only. Order reference for docs/warrior-build-plan-2026-11-01.md Phase 2; quest ids and coordinates in it are verified against tooling/qdb before use.

sources.source: Forever trainer prices (trainingcost, copper) from the Wowhead Forever NPC pages' teaches-ability / teaches-recipe listviews; read by verify.py --module money
sources.local_read: oldest "pulled" date of the NPC entries

upstream.method: browser only (www.wowhead.com returns 403 to a shell)
upstream.read: stale when the newest wowf build's created_at date is after the oldest pulled date

pull: open https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=258098 in Chrome and, from that tab, fetch('/forever/npc=<id>') for each NPC in the file about 1.3 s apart (about 25 fetches per burst before a 405)
parse every Listview whose rows carry trainingcost; profession ranks come as name + rank (Cooking, Journeyman) and are stored as "Journeyman Cooking" with rank null
rewrite tooling/trainer_costs.json in its one-row-per-spell layout, then python tooling/verify.py --all
sources.notes: Pulled 5 Nov 2026: Eldrun Stormbreaker 258098 (shaman, rows to level 40), Gremlock Pilsnor 1699 = Daryl Riknussun 5159 (cooking), Paxton Ganter 1700 = Grimnur Stonebrand 5161 (fishing), Thamner Pol 2326 = Nissa Firestone 5150 (first aid). Weapon masters (Buliwyf Stonehand 11865, Woo Ping 11867) have no training list on Wowhead, so weapon-skill prices stay unverified. 9 Nov 2026: every trainer re-pulled (all Eldrun rows to 60) and the 30-60 route trainers added: Ultham Ironhorn 4772 (Apprentice Riding raw 1052631 = 100g at Friendly), Telonis 4212 (LW to Expert), Drakk Stonehand 11097 (LW to Artisan), Thorkaf Dragoneye 7867 (Dragonscale recipes); Peter Galen 7866, Brumn Winterhoof 7869, Caryssia Moonhunter 7870, Farseer Maret Firetend 270263, Pratt McGrubben 7852, Dirge Quikcleave 8125, Nat Pagle 12919, Old Man Heming 2626, Deneb Walker 2805, Shandrina 3955 and Kelsey Yance 2664 carry no teaches list on Wowhead Forever (vendor prices are not on the NPC pages; book and recipe prices come from the item tooltip sell price x4). First Aid recipe costs read 5% higher than on 5 Nov (100 -> 105); whether the game shows 1s or 1s 5c is on the test list.

sources.source: Wowhead Forever drop chances for the quest items of the 30-60 route candidates: item pages' dropped-by listviews (count/outof per dropper, browser) plus the nether tooltip Drop Chance for single-dropper items; compiled by the Phase 2 script of 11 Nov 2026

upstream.method: browser only (www.wowhead.com returns 403 to a shell)
upstream.read: stale when the newest wowf build's created_at date is after "pulled" (a proxy: rates are sampled live and move without a build)

pull: open https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=<id> in Chrome (a tab already on wowhead.com; a freshly created tab sometimes refuses to navigate) and, from that tab, fetch('/forever/item=<id>') for up to a dozen items 3 s apart with a 15 s abort timeout; extract the "dropped-by" Listview data (count, outof per NPC)
python tooling/fetch_tooltips.py --from-file <single-dropper ids> for the items with one dropper (Drop Chance is on the tooltip)
rebuild data/drop_rates.json from the raw TSVs (one ITEM<tab><id><tab><json> line per item) and the tooltip file; set "pulled" here
sources.notes: 11 Nov 2026: 54 item pages (7 batches) + 52 tooltips = 106 items. count/outof counts every sampled kill, including players not on the quest, so it understates the on-quest rate; Wowhead Classic shows the same depressed figures for the same items (Bloodscalp Ear 21% vs 17%), so the numbers are a consistent yardstick for the 60/30 drop-quest rule. Class-quest items (Twisted Totems 274044-274047) read 4-15% because every player's kills are in the denominator; unusable. The bot check ("Let's confirm you are human") appeared after about 45 pages and cleared on its own in about 5 minutes.

sources.source: foreverdb.net/stats/shaman: per-level Agility-per-1%-crit and Intellect-per-1%-spell-crit for shamans from the Forever client's PlayerExpectedStat table, plus 2 AP per Str (ChrClasses); third-party extraction, cross-checked against Braedyn's character sheet at 21 on 8 Nov 2026
sources.local_read: "build" below (the client build the tables were extracted from, as the page states it)

upstream.read: the page's "build 1.60.1.NNNNN" label; STALE when it is newer than "build"

pull: read https://foreverdb.net/stats/shaman (levels 1-60 table) and put the 1/5/10/15/20/25/30/60 rows into _AGI_PER_CRIT and _INT_CRIT in weights/enh_weights.py
set "build" and "pulled" here, re-run python weights/enh_weights.py and weights/sensitivity.py into weights/weights_<date>.txt
sources.notes: Base crit, dodge per Agility and regen per Spirit are server-side (not in the client); those come from the character sheet (docs/forever-enh-stat-weights.md, Verify in game).

sources.source: wowforever.wclbox.com shaman spell pages: per-rank Earth Shock, Lightning Shield and Healing Wave values from the Forever client, with a dated beta-update history; third-party

upstream.read: the header's "Current build 1.60.1.NNNNN"; STALE when it is newer than "build"

pull: read the earth-shock, lightning-shield and healing-wave pages; update the rank tables in weights/enh_weights.py if a rank changed
set "build" and "pulled" here, re-run the model into weights/weights_<date>.txt
sources.notes: Earth Shock R1-R7 were raised to about Classic in build 1.60.1.70755 (3 Nov 2026); in game R3 reads 71-76 at level 21 (WCLBox base 69-74 plus within-rank level scaling). Wowhead Forever spell 1220751 gives the top-rank SP mod 0.386.

sources.source: Wowhead Forever spell tooltips for the Enhancement model (weights/enh_weights.py): Rockbiter 8017-16316, Windfury Weapon 8232/8235/10486/16362, Stormstrike 17364, Improved Stormstrike 1223031, Flurry 16256, Earth Shock 8042-10414, Lightning Shield 324-10432; plus the Spell Details values of eight spell pages (imbue passives, Earth Shock R5 coefficient, Improved Stormstrike rank curve) read in Chrome

upstream.read: stale when the newest wowf build's created_at date is after "pulled" (a proxy, as for item_tooltips)

pull: GET the endpoint for every id in the file with a Mozilla/5.0 User-Agent, one request per second; rewrite data/spell_tooltips.json ("items") and set "pulled" here and in the file
open https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=<id> in Chrome and, from that tab, fetch('/forever/spell=<id>') for the ids under "spell_pages" about 1.4 s apart; read the #spelldetails table
talent rank values (Flurry 6% per rank, Elemental Weapons, Tidal Focus, Mindfulness): https://wowforever.wclbox.com/en/tianfu/shaman (covered by wclbox_spells' build check)
update the tables in weights/enh_weights.py if a value changed and re-run the model into weights/weights_<date>.txt
sources.notes: 11 Nov 2026: 28 tooltips. The cast tooltips show level-60 values; the passive auras on the spell pages give the value at the rank's level (Rockbiter 88 / 129 / 211, Windfury 46 / 119). Stormstrike's tooltip says Requires level 40 while the talent is tier 4 (15 points) on WCLBox and in wowsims/forever's tree.
